topic_mapping_notes: Source topics I-III map directly to official PRC exam area POWER_ENERGY_MACHINERY.

Source topic IV ('Agricultural Economics and Marketing') is engineering-economy/feasibility content (NPV, IRR, BCR, depreciation, payback period) — mapped to official PRC exam area PROJECT_MGMT_RDE ('Project Management, Feasibility Study Preparation/Evaluation...') rather than POWER_ENERGY_MACHINERY. This is a judgment call, not a verified official classification — flag for admin review.
Source topic V ('AE Laws...') mapped to official PRC exam area LAWS_ETHICS.

Source's own weight labels (33% for this whole Part I, with sub-splits like 24%/23%/23%/20%/10%) come from Tambong's personal document and were NOT re-verified against the current official PRC Table of Specifications — do not treat as authoritative; official weights are recorded in 00_MASTER_PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS.md Section 3 instead.
known_source_discrepancies: Topic I question 'Jatropha oil expeller crude oil production rate': choice B is printed as '250 kg/min' in the source, but the source's own solution computes 250 kg/h (matching the marked Answer B). Likely a unit typo in the original material. Flagged, not silently corrected — see flag on that question below.

Topic III difficult question 4 (vermi cast shredder annual waste weight): the source's own worked solution computes 1,075 tonnes/yr, but the source marks 'Answer: C' where choice C = 1,750 tonnes (choice B = 1,075 tonnes). This is an internal inconsistency in the source material itself. Flagged for admin verification before publishing — see flag on that question below.

A 24-volt battery of a pineapple harvesting conveyor needs to be charged on field using 12-volt solar modules. What is the minimum number of solar modules required?
questions.explanation: Minimum no. of modules = No. of solar modules in series = 24v/12v = 2 modules

questions.q: A 12-volt battery of a boom sprayer needs to be charged on field using 6-volt solar modules with 2 modules in parallel to speed up charging. How many solar modules are required?
questions.explanation: No. of solar modules in series = 12v/6v = 2 modules. Total no. of solar modules = Modules in series x Modules in parallel = 2x2 = 4 modules

questions.q: What is the actual horsepower of a tractor which can do 149.2 kw-hrs of work in 2 hours?
questions.explanation: P = W/t x conversion factor = 149.2 kw-hrs/2hrs x 1 hp/0.746 kw = 100 hp

questions.q: What is the electrical energy consumption of a 30-kw vermin cast production shredder plugged in a 220-volt source if it requires 3 hours to shred 3 tonnes of farm waste?
questions.explanation: Ec = PcTo / Wi = 30 kw (3 h) / 3,000 kg = 0.03 kwh/kg

A 6-bladed windmill with 8 meters rotor diameter and 45 degrees twist angle is to be modified due to insufficient starting torque. What should be done?
questions.explanation: Increasing blades increases torque.

questions.q: A windmill with 6 meters rotor diameter, 5 cm pump diameter and 2 cm crank arm is to be modified due to low volumetric efficiency. What should be done?
questions.explanation: Elongating crank arm increases pump stroke and volumetric efficiency.

questions.q: A 3-bladed 40-meter tall aerogenerator with 20 meters rotor radius designed for 6 m/s wind can't rotate. Average windspeed at rotor center is 5.5 m/s. Which part needs to be increased?
questions.explanation: Windspeed is higher at higher elevation; increasing rotor radius will severely affect twist angle of entire blade & tip-speed ratio; aerogenerators have no crank arm.

questions.q: A 2-tonne capacity Jatropha oil expeller was loaded full with dried Jatropha seeds in 3 minutes. It produced 750 kg of crude oil in 3 hours. What is its crude oil production rate?
questions.explanation: Poil = Weight of crude oil collected / Total time = 750 kg / 3 h = 250 kg/h
questions.flag: Source prints choice B's unit as 'kg/min' but the source's own solution computes 250 kg/h, matching the marked answer. Likely a unit typo in the original material — verify before publishing.

questions.q: A castor bean oil expeller was loaded with 4.5 tonnes dried castor bean seeds. It produced 2,250 kg of crude oil in 4 hours. What is its castor bean cake production rate?
questions.explanation: Pcake = Weight of resulting cake produced / Total time = (4,500 kg seed - 2,250 kg oil) / 4 h = 562.5 kg/h

questions.q: A 10-tonne capacity coconut oil expeller was loaded full with grated copra. It produced 5,000 kg of crude oil in 10 hours. What is the copra cake production rate of the machine at 95% cake collection efficiency?
questions.explanation: Pcake = [(Wt. of copra input - Wt. of crude oil collected) / Total time] x Eff = [(10,000 kg - 5,000 kg) / 10 h] x 0.95 = 475 kg/h

questions.q: What is the weight of agricultural waste that is needed annually to optimally operate a 26-ampere 6-kw vermi cast production shredder having a capacity of 0.3 tonne of waste per hour? It optimally operates 16 hours daily during the 4-month peak sunny months and 8 h/day at 26 days/month for the rest of the year.
questions.explanation: Wt = Input Rate x (Peak Operating Time + Lean Operating Time) = [0.3 tonne/h][(16 h/d x 30 d/mo x 4 mo/yr) + (8 h/d x 26 d/mo x 8 mos/yr)] = 1,075 tonnes/yr. [CORRECTED after review: the source material marked choice C (1,750 tonnes) as the answer, but its own worked solution computes 1,075 tonnes (choice B). Reviewed and corrected by Gabriel on 2026-09-18 — 1,075 tonnes (B) is the verified correct answer.]

questions.q: Using financial feasibility analysis, the Net Present Values (NPVs) of farm-to-market road, irrigation and flood control projects are 22.5, 7.5 and -3.1 million pesos, while the Internal Rate of Returns (IRRs) are 15%, 7% and 2.1%, respectively. Annual discount plus inflation rate is 10%. Which project shall be implemented?
questions.explanation: Only the Farm-to-Market road project has IRR higher than discount plus inflation rate.

questions.q: Using straight line depreciation method, what is the book value at the end of the third year of a tractor purchased at Php 2,500,000 if its life span is assumed at 10 years? Salvage value is 10%.
questions.explanation: Depreciation = (Php2,500,000 - Php250,000) / 10 years = Php 225,000/year. Book value = Purchase price - total depreciations = Php2,500,000 - (Php225,000/yr x 3yrs) = P1,825,000

questions.q: Using economic feasibility analysis, the Net Present Values (NPVs) of small water impounding project (SWIP), shallow tubewell, small scale irrigation project (SSIP) are -0.5, -0.9 and 0 million pesos, respectively. The proposed projects are owned by the government. Which project is economically feasible?
questions.explanation: In economic analysis, NPV of 0 is feasible since it has economic benefits even if it is just break-even.

questions.q: Microhydro, solar electrification and covered lagoon biodigester projects are evaluated for financial feasibility. Each requires PHP 20,000,000 investment. Only one project can be funded. The financial internal rates of return are 15%, 9% and 8%, respectively. Annual discount plus inflation rate is 10%. Which project shall be implemented?
questions.explanation: Its IRR is higher than discount plus inflation rate.

questions.q: A banana production and export project is being evaluated for financial feasibility. At 12% annual discount rate, it has the following feasibility indicators: net present value of 1.8 billion pesos and internal rate of return of 58%. If annual discount rate drops to 9%, will it be feasible?
questions.explanation: If it is feasible at 12% discount rate, the more it will be feasible at 9%.
